contract.intent: Amend the tree-format-spec to bound depth and path length for long-lived projects: sibling-correction (repairs/amendments never nest), pruning of completed subtrees, name discipline, path budget.
acceptanceCriteria: depth-policy.md artifact exists at artifacts/ — back-references tree-format-spec.md and supersedes §1 (layout) and §7 (engine ACs) where noted
Sibling-correction semantics defined: retries/amendments = same-level siblings with higher prefix, never nested children
Pruning rule defined: completed/superseded subtrees may be removed from working tree; git is the archive; live nodes' requiredInputs block pruning of referenced nodes
Depth expectation + path budget stated (<=8 levels, <=260 chars full path)
Name discipline stated (segments <=24 chars, kebab-case, no dates/versions in names)
Engine ACs added: F-AC9 (sibling retry), F-AC10 (prune keeps tree valid)
02-tree-format node gets an 'extended' event pointing at this amendment
